# Spec: prisma

<!-- Generated by `averri docs` from the semantic graph. Do not edit. -->

## ApiKey
Intent: Organization API key; the secret is shown once and rotation bumps `version`.
Invariants:
  - versionIsPositive: self.version >= 1   [declared]
  - roleIsGrantable: self.role in [admin, member]   [declared]
Owner: team-platform · Last change: —

## AuditLog
Intent: Append-only record of who did what inside an organization.
Owner: team-platform · Last change: —

## AuthToken
Intent: Bearer token for a user; only the SHA-256 hash is stored.
Owner: team-platform · Last change: —

## Invitation
Intent: One invitation per organization and email; re-inviting a pending email resends it.
Invariants:
  - pendingHasNoAcceptedAt: self.status != "pending" or self.acceptedAt is null   [declared]
  - acceptedHasAcceptor: self.status != "accepted" or self.acceptedById is set   [declared]
  - revokedHasTimestamp: self.status != "revoked" or self.revokedAt is set   [declared]
  - roleIsGrantable: self.role in [admin, member]   [declared]
  - resendCountNonNegative: self.resendCount >= 0   [declared]
Owner: team-platform · Last change: —

## Membership
Intent: Who belongs to an organization and with which role.
Invariants:
  - roleIsKnown: self.role in [owner, admin, member]   [declared]
Owner: team-platform · Last change: —

## Organization
Intent: The tenant. Soft-deleted organizations keep their rows but reject every request.
Owner: team-platform · Last change: —

## Project
Intent: An organization-scoped container for tasks with a short unique key.
Invariants:
  - archivedHasTimestamp: self.status != "archived" or self.archivedAt is set   [declared]
  - activeHasNoArchivedAt: self.status != "active" or self.archivedAt is null   [declared]
  - taskCounterNonNegative: self.taskCounter >= 0   [declared]
  - statusIsKnown: self.status in [active, archived]   [declared]
Owner: team-product · Last change: —

## Subscription
Intent: Billing state mirrored from Stripe webhooks; one row per organization.
Invariants:
  - seatsArePositive: self.seats >= 1   [declared]
  - planIsKnown: self.plan in [free, pro, enterprise]   [declared]
  - statusIsKnown: self.status in [active, trialing, past_due, canceled, incomplete]   [declared]
Owner: team-billing · Last change: —

## Task
Intent: A numbered task inside a project; `completedAt` is set exactly when status is done.
Invariants:
  - doneHasCompletedAt: self.status != "done" or self.completedAt is set   [declared]
  - openHasNoCompletedAt: self.status = "done" or self.completedAt is null   [declared]
  - numberIsPositive: self.number >= 1   [declared]
  - statusIsKnown: self.status in [todo, in_progress, done]   [declared]
Owner: team-product · Last change: —

## User
Intent: A person who can sign in. Emails are stored lower-cased and are unique.
Owner: team-platform · Last change: —

## WebhookEvent
Intent: Every accepted webhook delivery, unique per provider event id (idempotency).
Invariants:
  - statusIsKnown: self.status in [processed, ignored, failed]   [declared]
Owner: team-billing · Last change: —
